frequency_question: How often does a central bank raise the CCyB from zero within a comparable window?
membership_rule: Members are G20 central banking authorities with an active CCyB framework in place, observed in rolling 3-year observation intervals from 2016 to 2026. Excluded are jurisdictions without a functional macroprudential buffer mechanism.
